title: Matrix proof function
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $P$ be a Boolean table indexed by the disjoint union of sets of sizes $2^n$ and $2^{n^2}$. The associated function on $n\times n$ matrices over the field with two elements evaluates $P$ at the index of the flattened matrix in the second summand, then interprets the resulting Boolean value as an element of the field with two elements.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a Boolean table indexed by a set of size $2^n+2^{n^2}$
